description:
Team Rochette is named after the rock in Jezero Crater where the Perseverance rover collected its first core samples. We are a team of two, a mother and son: a full-stack developer and a young NASA fan who is our first mission tester.

We are working on the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge with Mars to Go, a mobile-first game where kids run a Mars base on real Martian terrain and learn that math, logic and real NASA data are how you bring a crew home.
